Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.
Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format.
Pay the application fee online, if applicable.
Review all details carefully before submitting the form.
Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for IIT Madras Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of the online application for the Research Associate-I post at IIT Madras is 02 September 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Research Associate-I posts at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Research Associate-I position in the latest recruitment drive by the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. Interested candidates should check the detailed notification for post-specific eligibility.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for IIT Madras Research Associate-I Recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the IIT Madras Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026 is Online. Candidates need to visit the official website of IIT Madras and follow the instructions to fill out and submit their application forms electronically.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Research Associate-I position at IIT Madras will receive a salary of Rs. 58,000 per month. This is a contractual position, and further details regarding benefits can be found in the official advertisement.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Research Associate-I at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an MA/MSc/MTech/PhD in Linguistics and/or Cognitive Science with relevant experience and a refereed and indexed journal publication. Interdisciplinary research experience and computational data analysis skills are highly desirable.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for IIT Madras Research Associate-I Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for the IIT Madras Research Associate-I Recruitment 2026. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for Research Associate-I at IIT Madras?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate-I position typically involves shortlisting of applications, followed by a test or interview. Final selection will also include document verification to confirm eligibility and credentials.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the Research Associate-I position be located?
faq.answer: The Research Associate-I position is based in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, at the Indian Institute of Technology Madras. Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Chennai if selected for the role.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website for IIT Madras recruitment?
faq.answer: The official website for IIT Madras recruitment and to apply for the Research Associate-I post is https://icandsr.iitm.ac.in. All official notifications and application links will be available on this portal.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from any state apply for this IIT Madras recruitment?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates from across India are generally eligible to apply for government job notifications like this one at IIT Madras, provided they meet all the specified eligibility criteria including qualification and age limits.
